race.comment: HARRY'S EVIDENCE (9) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome last time out but go on the solid victory here when resuming. Only needs some luck navigating from the wide draw to be playing a major role in the outcome. WEST OF DALBY (14) hit the line strongly in Saturday metro grade at the latest outing and will appreciate the extra journey here. Should find this a touch easier. UNSTOPABULL (3) has won over this track and trip, gets gun hoop Rawiller on board and is drawn to get a cosy run in transit from the inside alley. Ticks a few boxes. MAGICAL MOMENTS (5) worth including in all multiples.
